scope: Retrospective interpretation of published TCR–pMHC cases and existing model predictions; no sequence design, inference, training or MD production.

MEL5.title: T-cell Receptor Specificity Maintained by Altered Thermodynamics
MEL5.fixed_pMHC: HLA-A*02:01 presenting MART-1 heteroclitic decamer ELAGIGILTV

measurements.result: Parent MEL5 KD 18 micromolar; alpha24beta17 KD 0.6 nanomolar, approximately 30000-fold affinity change; longer binding lifetime is an important kinetic contribution.
measurements.locator: Results, The alpha24beta17 TCR Binds to A2-ELA with High Affinity Due to an Extended Off-rate; Figure 1

measurements.result: The overall docking geometry and peptide conformation are similar; MHC contacts are 56 versus 97 and peptide contacts 39 versus 42.
Beta CDR2 contact counts increase from 6 to 38. E58 is specifically identified as an MHC residue involved in a new alpha CDR1 contact.
measurements.locator: Table 1; Results, New Interactions with the MHC Surface and Figure 3

measurements.result: High affinity binding to the original peptide is entropically favorable and enthalpically unfavorable; the paper emphasizes solvent reorganization/expulsion in the specificity interpretation.
measurements.locator: Experimental Procedures, Surface Plasmon Resonance Experiments; Results, Peptide Specificity Is Governed by Altered Entropy and a Reduction in Water Bridges; Figures 6–7

MEL5.paper_MD_RMSF_Hchi: The original study did not report MD, RMSF or the model's joint chi-state entropy. Our local dynamics and ITrace MD evidence have separate provenance.
MEL5.interpretation: Existing model RMSF and Hchi can supply complementary local dynamics around the experimentally established contact reorganization. They do not reconstruct solvent entropy or the measured affinity ratio.

JM22_F5L.title: Molecular basis for universal HLA-A*0201-restricted CD8+ T-cell immunity against influenza viruses
JM22_F5L.comparison: Same JM22 TCR and HLA-A*02:01; peptide GILGFVFTL versus GILGLVFTL

facts.result: WT KD 1.79 +/- 0.5 micromolar; F5L KD greater than 200 micromolar, not an exact value of 200.
WT and F5L pHLA melting temperatures are similar, 65.8 +/- 1.2 versus 65.6 +/- 0.6 degrees Celsius.
Variant peptide changes conformation on TCR binding to resemble WT, interpreted as induced-fit molecular mimicry. F5L does not require an overall rearrangement of JM22 CDR loops.
facts.locator: Figure 4 and The Public JM22 TCR Recognizes M1 Variants via Induced-Fit Molecular Mimicry

JM22_F5L.paper_MD_RMSF_Hchi: The original study did not measure our bound-state RMSF/Hchi. Its unligated-to-ligated structural changes are not direct measurements of the difference between our two ligated-state Hchi predictions.

SB27_SB47.title: Highly Divergent T-cell Receptor Binding Modes Underlie Specific Recognition of a Bulged Viral Peptide Bound to a Human Leukocyte Antigen Class I Molecule

facts.result: SB27 straddles the bulged central peptide, whereas SB47 uses an N-terminally focused docking footprint and extensive MHC contacts.
SB27 is sensitive to substitutions in central peptide positions including P7; SB47 tolerates many substitutions at P7–P12 and has more N-terminally focused fine specificity.
facts.locator: Figure 1 and Results, Fine Specificity of the ... clones

facts.result: The study measured binding and HLA restriction; the model's Q7 dynamic changes should support different recognition constraints rather than claim a predicted affinity ratio.
